text.zh_CN: 收盘了。第一天最重要的是建立节奏，而不是赚多少。明天开盘前，你只有一个目标：账户权益达到 10.3 万美元，同时保留至少 40% 现金。
text.en: The close is in. Day one is about building rhythm, not making money. Before tomorrow's open, your only goal is $103,000 equity while keeping at least 40% in cash.

text.zh_CN: 接受。先控制风险，再谈收益。

toast.zh_CN: 目标已记下：收盘时自己对照权益与现金
toast.en: Goal noted: check equity and cash at the close

text.en: Decline. I have my own process.

text.zh_CN: 很好。打开持仓页，看清楚每一项暴露。明天的每一笔交易，都要能回答“这笔仓位为什么存在”。
text.en: Good. Open the Portfolio screen and read every exposure. Tomorrow, every trade must answer one question: why does this position exist?

text.zh_CN: 可以。但请把你的规则写下来，并在收盘时对照。没有书面规则的自由，通常只是随机的另一种说法。
text.en: Fine. But write your rules down and check them at every close. Freedom without written rules is usually randomness by another name.
